public_rationale: PwC found that 56% of surveyed CEOs reported no significant financial benefit from AI. That supports the main majority claim on its ordinary reading. Zitron's supporting citation is imprecise: the roughly 6,000 respondents included CFOs and other executives, and that study measured employment and productivity rather than financial return. This finding does not validate an 80% no-ROI statistic.
limitations: Support depends on reading return on investment as significant financial benefit.
Survey responses are not audited investment returns.
The cited study's population and measures are described inaccurately.
